chats.answer:
For a 16-inch laptop, I'd recommend a screen extender with a 15.6-inch or 16-inch display, ideally with USB-C connectivity and a sturdy support mechanism.

The biggest decision is whether you want a dual-screen extender (one additional screen) or a triple-screen setup (two additional screens attached to your laptop).

My preference is a single 16-inch portable monitor with a built-in stand for reliability, but if you specifically want screens that attach to your laptop, there are several good options.

My top picks for a 16-inch laptop

1. MagHub Dual Lite 16" Portable Screen Extender

Two additional 16-inch 1920×1200 screens, detachable design, ideal for a three-display workstation.

4. ViewSonic 16" Portable WQXGA IPS Monitor with 65W USB-C and …

$329.99

View product
One important compatibility question

A 16-inch screen size alone doesn't guarantee an extender will fit. You also need to check the laptop's physical width, thickness, USB-C video support, and ability to drive multiple external displays.

Which 16-inch laptop do you have? For example, MacBook Pro 16, Lenovo Legion, ThinkPad, Dell XPS 16, or ASUS ROG.

With the exact model, I can narrow this down to the best-fitting extender rather than just the best-rated products.

For a 16-inch laptop, I'd recommend a screen extender with 15.6–16-inch displays, 1920×1200 resolution, and an independent kickstand. That gives you a good size match without putting too much weight on your laptop's hinges.

Here are my top picks for 2026, depending on whether you want one or two additional screens.

Best budget dual-screen
$149.99

Two 16-inch additional screens at a much lower price than most premium alternatives.
